messages.subject: [R-GSoC 2019] Second evaluations this week
messages.body_plain:
All,

I've heard a lot of really encouraging reports of progress on multiple
projects this summer. (and an equally encouragingly low incidence of
major problems)

The GSoC second evaluation opens *today* (in about an hour from this
message), and closes on *Friday* 12 July, this week.

All students and one mentor from each team must complete the
evaluation inside this timeframe.

There are consequences for not completing the evaluations.

Students, you won't get paid, and will be automatically failed by
Google if you don't complete your evaluation by the deadline.

Mentors, Google will penalize organizations that don't complete
all student evaluations.  Google and I will hound you this week
to get it done.  Please be good to Toby and me, as well as to
the org and your students, and get them done early this week if
possible.

If evaluations are not done a few hours before the deadline, we
will need to fail the project for lack of mentor involvement.

Google (and we) expect that there have likely been some schedule
and scope changes through the process of coding.  This is normal.
We hope that students and mentors are communicating regularly
and adapting as things change or come up.

As always, please reach out to Toby or me privately with any
questions.

Regards,

Brian

--
Brian G. Peterson
http://braverock.com/brian/
Ph: 773-459-4973
IM: bgpbraverock
